hni_signals: Profile is academic and research-led rather than ownership-led. ACADEMIC DISTINCTIONS, publicly stated: awarded Best Outgoing Student of the Department of Medical Oncology, and ranked 2nd in medical oncology at Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS). INTERNATIONAL SOCIETY MEMBERSHIPS: ESMO (European Society for Medical Oncology), ASCO (American Society of Clinical Oncology), and AMOP (Academic Medical Oncology Program). PUBLICATION RECORD, independently verifiable and genuinely substantial for her career stage: named co-author on a 14-institution multicentre Indian real-world study of gemcitabine-cisplatin plus durvalumab in advanced biliary tract cancers (148 patients), published in JCO Global Oncology 2024 and indexed on PubMed, carrying her AIG Institute of Oncology affiliation; the same work was presented earlier as abstract P-209 in Annals of Oncology; and she co-authored a Phase 3 randomised clinical trial of olanzapine as antiemetic prophylaxis in moderately emetogenic chemotherapy, in PubMed Central. Multi-centre trial participation and an ASCO-journal publication indicate she sits inside a national oncology research network. She sits in AIG's Institute of Oncology, the group's flagship cancer unit. NO founder, owner, Director, Chairman or HOD title, no separate clinic, and no publicly stated procedure or case volume was found - do not infer any.
